recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現一團彼此黏附的大型非造血細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻，淡藍色細胞質邊緣布滿小空泡，這種「成團、黏聚」的排列提示轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤（此例為胚胎型橫紋肌肉瘤 embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells, with focal nuclear molding
Moderate to high N:C ratio with round to oval, slightly eccentric nuclei
Finely granular to smooth chromatin with small, inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with ragged, frayed borders
Numerous small discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, concentrated at the cell periphery
Background of red cells with a small platelet clump; no normal hematopoietic precursors within the cluster
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large, non-hematopoietic-appearing cells set in a background of red cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with frayed borders and numerous small peripheral vacuoles. Nuclear molding and tight cell-to-cell cohesion favor a metastatic solid tumor over acute leukemia. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small round blue cell tumor; in this context, metastatic embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma, to be confirmed by desmin and myogenin (MyoD1) immunohistochemistry on the biopsy.

ddx.vs: Morphology on aspirate cannot reliably separate the subtypes; alveolar RMS shows diffuse strong myogenin staining and PAX3/PAX7::FOXO1 fusion, whereas embryonal RMS is fusion-negative with patchy myogenin.
Neuroblastoma cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and form Homer Wright rosettes around neurofibrillary material, rather than showing vacuolated cytoplasm with frayed borders.
Ewing cells form similar clusters with vacuoles (PAS-positive glycogen) but are CD99 and NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement and lack desmin/myogenin.
Burkitt cells lie singly rather than in cohesive molded clusters and have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles, expressing CD19/CD20 and surface light chain.
